formula_description: geoMean(q, d, p) = (q/10)^W_q * (d/10)^W_d * (p/10)^W_p * 10, where axis scores are 0-10 scale. Display score = Math.round(geoMean * 10). Minimum axis input clamped to 0.01 before normalization.

axis_stretch.notes: No axis stretch in v1.0. Enable when 10+ products scored to compute real category ranges.

sub_type_note: Solid and engineered scored within the same framework. Sub-type does NOT create automatic tier advantage. Sub-type-specific spec fields coexist — inapplicable fields omitted per product.

calibration_products.name: Carlisle Wide Plank White Oak (Solid, 3/4")
calibration_products.notes: Tier 1 anchor (solid). Custom wide plank heritage manufacturer — Stoddard, NH since 1966. Single-source US manufacturing. NWFA member. Select & Better grade white oak. Premium factory or site finish options. Hand-selected Appalachian hardwood. Artisanal quality benchmark — 'Rolls Royce of solid hardwood.' Wide plank 5-10"+ widths. Precision kiln-dried.

calibration_products.name: Mirage Sweet Memories White Oak (Engineered, 5/8")
calibration_products.notes: Tier 1 anchor (engineered). Québec-based precision manufacturer — gold standard for factory-finished engineered. 3.5mm sawn white oak veneer on multi-ply Baltic birch core. NanoLinx aluminum oxide finish (7+ coats). 35-year finish warranty. Lifetime structural warranty. Greenguard Gold certified. Tightest milling tolerance in category per installer consensus. Wire-brushed texture.

calibration_products.name: Mercier Design+ White Oak (Engineered, 5/8")
calibration_products.notes: Tier 2 upper anchor (engineered). Québec manufacturer, 70+ years. 3mm sawn veneer. Generations finish with Greenguard Gold. Strong installer consensus but milling slightly below Mirage precision. Competitive pricing. Strong warranty. FSC-certified options.

calibration_products.name: Lauzon Designer White Oak (Engineered, 5/8")
calibration_products.notes: Tier 2 lower anchor (engineered). Québec manufacturer. 3mm sawn veneer. Pure Genius air-purifying technology (TiO2 photocatalyst). Titanium finish. Competitive with Mercier, slightly narrower distribution. Third-strongest of the Québec cluster.

calibration_products.name: Somerset Character White Oak (Solid, 3/4")
calibration_products.notes: Tier 3 anchor (solid). Somerset, KY US manufacturer. NWFA/NOFMA certified. Character grade (#1 Common equivalent). AlumaPLUS aluminum oxide finish. Good value solid hardwood. Consistent milling for mid-tier. Strong for price point. Independent manufacturer.

calibration_products.name: Shaw Repel White Oak (Engineered, 1/2")
calibration_products.notes: Tier 3 lower anchor (engineered). Shaw Industries (Berkshire Hathaway). 2mm sawn veneer — limits refinishing to 1-2 light sandings. Repel water-resistant technology. ScufResist Platinum finish. Strong distribution and warranty infrastructure. 1/2" total thickness. Adequate but not premium construction.

calibration_products.name: Bruce Dundee White Oak (Solid, 3/4")
calibration_products.notes: Tier 4 upper anchor (solid). AHF Products (formerly Armstrong/Bruce). Volume leader for builder-grade 3/4" solid. Standard aluminum oxide finish. Commodity milling tolerance. 2-1/4" to 3-1/4" strip widths. Widest distribution. Functional but no differentiation. Quality perception declining.

calibration_products.name: Bruce Hydropel White Oak (Engineered, 3/8")
calibration_products.notes: Tier 4 lower anchor (engineered). AHF Products. Hydropel water-resistant technology. 1.2mm rotary-peeled veneer — NOT refinishable, replace-when-worn. 3/8" total thickness. Click-lock floating floor. Thin rotary veneer is the quality cliff — below this it's not meaningfully 'hardwood.'
